items.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15
items.q: Him and Bé-Shane played the same way.

ctx.x: Mr. Rene, he said, oh yeah, come on in, Rene.

I got to talk, and I said, oh, you playing that flute? I said, you play that flute? Well, good. Then I began questioning him about making them shorts and them flats, you see. Right. Because the fellow didn't know how to make them kind of things on the flute can't do nothing, but he did, you see. Then he could blow his soul powerful, then he could force some different tones out of it. The boy could hear him play a fight. Him and Bé-Shane played the same way. I said, I told him, I said, look, I said, I think we…
he went and bought the clan there. He got a beef-like clan there. Can you remember the name of where he bought it? Oh, let's see. You know, you weren't talking about it.
